rawContent: @ForeBizServices @cvpayne It's interesting how Twitter commenters are trying to concoct an "other side" equivalent to white supremacists and calling it Antifa BLM. If by BLM you mean #BlackLivesMatter - I mean, if you think the Philando Castile murder was justified, there's something wrong with you.

@ForeBizServices @cvpayne Regarding #BlackLivesMatter: You're getting your POC mixed up. Just because some black is disrespectful or even criminal doesn't mean they belong to or represent the cause. Quite the opposite, actually.

@ForeBizServices @cvpayne I'm just saying, that's why #BlackLivesMatter is an important movement - not just for Castile, but for Diallou, Rice, Stansbury, and many others that were unarmed. It was supposed to draw attention to unconscious bias amongst some police officers, and for the public to care.
